newsitem.title: OMAN: Air India leaves Oman after bomb threat.
newsitem.headline: Air India leaves Oman after bomb threat.

text.p: An Air India flight, forced to make an emergency landing in Oman after receiving a bomb threat, left Muscat for Trivandrum on Sunday, airport sources said.

The plane, carrying 91 passengers, landed in Oman on Saturday afternoon shortly after taking off from Dubai. An anonymous caller had telephoned Trivandrum airport in India and said there was a bomb abroad, they added.
"It was immediately diverted to Muscat airport, which was the nearest airport, passengers were taken to a nearby hotel, and the aircraft was fully searched," one source told Reuters.
"Police found nothing and the plane took off this morning (Sunday) to its scheduled destination," he added.
